grand_mesa.name: Grand Mesa
grand_mesa.note: DEM is the LiDAR-derived snow-off reference DTM from the HRSI collection. Carries two campaigns: SnowEx 2017 (ASO) and 2020. They cover the same ground, so they must never be split across train and test.

lidar.note: LiDAR-derived snow-off reference DTM from the HRSI collection. Resampled 1 m -> 3 m.

mores_creek.name: Mores Creek
mores_creek.note: Snow depth from the QSI campaign (2020-2021). Further surveys exist for 2022-2026 over the same ground but have no matching radar; see the comment in sources.

reynolds_creek.name: Reynolds Creek
reynolds_creek.note: No snow-depth product. DEM is from a different campaign and year than the vegetation-height survey.

lidar.note: 2014 lidar DEM from the ORNL DAAC Idaho vegetation-height collection, six years before the 2020 snow survey. Terrain is stable; recorded in identification/.
